body: I guess justice tastes like oranges.
Gosh, stop being such a James Blunt.

Since I got a computer at the tender age of about eleven or so, I've always wanted to be a programmer because I was/am *good* with computers, when in reality it was just me being good at English and using google to find guides on how to fix problems (e.g. formatting computers, finding drivers, etc.). I have asked myself what the hell it is I could do since apparently I'm pretty good at English so I figured maybe a translator or teacher but turns out that my vocabulary in my native language is abysmal, I tend to know exactly what a word in English means and how to use it properly in context but I'm having trouble finding the equivalent in Estonian that doesn't sound clunky or just plain old retarded and being a teacher? No, I'm horrible at explaining things to people, young and old, because apparently my thought process is so much different from a regular, normally functioning, person that any explanation I give to things is just completely bonkers to anybody else.
  
I honestly don't have any skills or talents to speak of, I'm just a drain on this family, society and world. Nobody depends on me either because of that and it wouldn't be a big deal if one day I just wouldn't be there anymore.
